fusions.name: Nothing Unseen
fusions.desc: A fixed look that deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.8 times their remaining damage to the hit. Its damage rises 10% per affliction on the target (max 50%). Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Withering Regard
fusions.desc: A stare across a cone 5 tiles long that deals 7 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance to leave each [Suppressed] for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Lidless Finial
fusions.desc: Plants the rod for 10 seconds. It strikes for 3 damage every second within 4 tiles, each strike with a 30% chance to leave the target [Exposed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Glance Tally
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 12. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (326% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
